name: CheckOutFile
description: Checks out a file from a SharePoint document library using Microsoft Graph, locking it for editing until it is checked in.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialName__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the file you want to check out. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFile.txt

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file check-out operation, including success status and any error messages.
